title: Monitoring
subtitle: Health, updates and activity across your projects, servers and domains.

monitoringHint.description: See service status and manage background monitoring.

resolvedNote: History covers container and server incidents — the other checks report current state, so a fixed certificate or deploy simply stops appearing here.

scopeSubtitles.server: The machines your workloads run on

selfUpdateNote: This installation updates itself from the command line.

empty.openBody: No deploys blocked or waiting, no certificate or domain problems, nothing behind, nothing on the wrong port. Checks keep running in the background.
empty.resolvedBody: Container and server incidents appear here once they recover, and are kept for 30 days.
empty.filteredBody: Some issues are open — none match this filter.

connectivity.offlineHint: Displayed status may be out of date. Reconnect to refresh it.

titles.partialDecision: Some services failed — keep or reject this release

messages.domainDnsUnverified: DNS for this hostname hasn't verified yet. Check the records, then re-run the check.
messages.routingUnsynced: The deploy succeeded but its edge route didn't sync, so the public URL may not resolve yet. Retrying re-runs just the routing step — it does not rebuild.
messages.certHttpsWillFail: HTTPS will fail for this hostname until a certificate is issued. Renewing re-runs issuance.
messages.partialServices: Some services failed to come up. The rest are live. Keep the release, or reject it to roll back to the previous one.
messages.partialNamedServices: These services failed: {services}. The rest are live. Keep the release, or reject it to roll back to the previous one.
messages.noCertOnServer: No usable HTTPS certificate was found on the server.
messages.dnsOtherServer: DNS points to a different server
messages.certEdgeFailed: Couldn't confirm a certificate ({detail}). Make sure the domain points at this server (a CDN like Cloudflare in front is fine) and ports 80/443 are reachable, then Verify again.
